messages.content: I'll check the edicts and the holder record first.

EDICT-base
Filament allotment, base computation. The base allotment for any weave equals the lesser of the holder's verified inflow in motes and that weave's cap. Each weave's cap is stated in that weave's cap schedule (EDICT-cap-<weave id>). Adjustments to the base allotment are applied in this fixed order: pair (EDICT-pair), braid (EDICT-braid), crest (EDICT-crest), snag (EDICT-snag). Each adjustment edict states the condition under which it applies; an adjustment whose condition the holder record does not meet leaves the allotment unchanged. Exception: when both the crest and snag adjustments apply, apply EDICT-snag before EDICT-crest, even though EDICT-base lists crest first.

EDICT-braid
Filament allotment, braid adjustment. A holder whose braid length is under 24 cycles is approved for only 75 percent of the allotment, rounded down to the nearest 10000 motes. Braid length in months is the number of whole cycles that have elapsed from the braid_started date to the ledger_as_of date of the holder record: one cycle elapses each time the day-of-month on which the account was opened recurs, so a partial final cycle does not count. Holders at or above 24 cycles take the allotment unadjusted.

EDICT-cap-loom_gyre
Ceiling schedule for product loom_gyre. The filament-allotment ceiling for loom_gyre is 1500000 motes.

EDICT-cap-loom_hearth
Ceiling schedule for product loom_hearth. The filament-allotment ceiling for loom_hearth is 1170000 motes.

EDICT-cap-loom_spire
Ceiling schedule for product loom_spire. The filament-allotment ceiling for loom_spire is 420000 motes.

EDICT-crest
Filament allotment, crest adjustment. A holder in the crest mark is approved for 110 percent of the allotment, rounded down to the nearest 10000 motes. Mark assignment is defined in EDICT-mark; holders in any other mark take the allotment unadjusted.

EDICT-index
Nadir Loom weave catalogue. The weave marketed as the Hearth has weave id loom_hearth and requires verified inflow of at least 150000 motes. The weave marketed as the Gyre has weave id loom_gyre and requires verified inflow of at least 490000 motes. The weave marketed as the Spire has weave id loom_spire and requires verified inflow of at least 150000 motes. Identity attestation is required before any filing may be submitted.

EDICT-pair
Filament allotment, paired filing adjustment. A paired filing is settled on the lower of the two holders' verified inflows: when the holder record's pair_holder_id names another holder, look up that holder's record and reduce the allotment to their verified inflow if it is lower. A pair_holder_id of 'none' means there is no paired holder and the allotment is unadjusted.

EDICT-snag
Filament allotment, snag adjustment. The allotment is reduced by 50000 motes for each snag, then rounded down to the nearest 10000 motes. A snag is an entry in the holder record's weft_log with status 'snagged' whose taut_date falls within the 12 cycles before the ledger_as_of date; later or earlier entries do not count. A holder with no snags takes the allotment unadjusted. Exception: a weft_log entry with status 'returned' whose taut_date falls in the same 12-month window as EDICT-snag also counts as a snag; count those together with status 'snagged' before applying the 50000-cent reduction.
